name: adjacent
title: Adjacent
description: Browse, search, and read news on Adjacent prediction markets, indices, and rates.
author: Lucas-Kohorst

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse
commands.subtitle: Adjacent
commands.description: Browse events, markets, indices, and rates.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search
commands.subtitle: Adjacent
commands.description: Find events, markets, indices, and rates.

commands.name: news
commands.title: News
commands.subtitle: Adjacent
commands.description: Latest headlines and related markets. API key required.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Adjacent
commands.description: Live index levels in the menu bar.

tools.name: find
tools.title: Find
tools.description: Discover markets, events, indices, rates, or news by topic when you do not have an id yet.

tools.name: get
tools.title: Get
tools.description: Fetch full detail for one Adjacent entity by type and id.

tools.name: list
tools.title: List
tools.description: Browse Adjacent events, markets, indices, rates, or latest news.

tools.name: price
tools.title: Price
tools.description: Price history for an index, rate, market, or event over a human timeframe.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Optional Adjacent API key (ak_…). Without a key, lists and prices use the 15-minute-delayed public snapshot. News, candles, similar markets, trades, and quotes need a key.

preferences.name: defaultTimeframe
preferences.title: Default Price Window
preferences.description: Used when opening price history from a detail view.

preferences.name: cycleSeconds
preferences.title: Menu Bar Cycle
preferences.description: How long each index stays in the menu bar before the next one.
